content.rendered:
Our office is closed for the summer starting June 24th – August 16th.

For urgent assistance, please visit our District Office located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd. The District office is open Monday – Thursday, 7:30 am – 4:00 pm.

Registration is now online! Please visit HTTPS://BIT.LY/SSD-OLR for online registration, or contact the District office at 503-825-5000 for assistance.
